steps.en: Install the cockpit package on the server
steps.zh: 在服务器上安装 cockpit 包
steps.code: sudo dnf install cockpit · sudo pacman -S cockpit

steps.en: Enable the socket — no daemon runs until someone connects
steps.zh: 启用 socket——没人连接就没有常驻进程

steps.en: Serves HTTPS on 9090 and logs you in with the machine's own Linux credentials
steps.zh: 在 9090 提供 HTTPS，用机器自己的 Linux 账号登录

steps.en: Starts a bridge inside a real login session that runs systemctl, journal, podman for you
steps.zh: 在真实登录会话里拉起桥，替你跑 systemctl、podman

steps.en: Manage services, storage, logs and accounts from the browser; CLI and UI stay in sync
steps.zh: 在浏览器里管服务、存储、日志和账号，命令行与 UI 实时同步

value.en: A browser pane of glass on the machine's live state — uninstall tomorrow and nothing depended on it
value.zh: 一块映照机器实时状态的浏览器面板，明天卸载也没任何东西依赖过它

sources: cockpit-project.org/running.html (retrieved 2026-09-28): sudo dnf install cockpit; sudo pacman -S cockpit; sudo systemctl enable --now cockpit.socket; https://IP_ADDRESS_OF_MACHINE:9090; cockpit-ws container name

README.md main @ 2026-09-28: 'interacts directly with the operating system from a real Linux session', tasks include starting containers, storage administration, network configuration, inspecting logs; add other machines via SSH
src/cockpit/bridge.py main @ 2026-09-28 — Python bridge implementation (cockpit-bridge man page: doc/man/cockpit-bridge.1.adoc)
